description: Resource Type definition for AWS::CloudWatch::AccessGrant. An access grant authorizes a principal to perform a set of actions on resources in a space.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the access grant.

GrantId.description: The unique ID of the access grant.

Name.description: A name that identifies the access grant.

DomainId.description: The ID of the domain the grant belongs to.

SpaceId.description: The space this grant applies to. Domain-scoped grants are returned by ListDomainAccessGrantsForOrganization instead.

ScopedActions.description: Groups of actions allowed by the grant, each with the resource scopes and conditions that limit those actions.

AccountId.description: The AWS account ID that owns the grant.

CreatedBy.description: The principal that created the grant.

CreatedAt.description: The timestamp when the grant was created.

UpdatedAt.description: The timestamp when the grant was last updated.

Tags.description: An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key name of the tag.

AccessGrantPrincipal.description: The principal receiving the grant. Specify PrincipalId, PrincipalAttributes, or both.

PrincipalType.description: The type of principal receiving the grant.

PrincipalId.description: The ID of the principal receiving the grant. An IAM principal ARN, an Identity Center UUID, or a service-defined identifier.

PrincipalAttributes.description: Attribute conditions for attribute-based access. When provided, the grant targets any principal matching all specified conditions. Supported only for IDC_USER principals.

AccessGrantPrincipalAttribute.description: A single attribute condition used to match principals for attribute-based access.

Key.description: The Identity Center user attribute to match on. One of userName, active, userStatus, displayName, email, name.givenName, name.familyName, enterprise.department, enterprise.division, enterprise.organization, enterprise.costCenter, or enterprise.employeeNumber.

ScopedActions.description: A group of actions within an access grant, together with the resource scopes and context conditions that apply to exactly those actions.

Actions.description: The actions this group applies to, each in vendor-code:Action form.

Resources.description: Resource scopes constraining these actions to specific resources.

ContextConditions.description: Context conditions for fine-grained access control on these actions, as a map of condition keys to lists of allowed values.

ResourceScope.description: A single resource scope entry within an access grant. Associates a resource type with optional ARN patterns, tag conditions, and row-level filters.

ResourceType.description: The resource type name, for example DataSet or OmniDashboard.

ResourceArns.description: Specific resource ARNs or ARN patterns. When set, actions are limited to these resources. When absent, defaults to all resources of the type.

Tags.description: Tag-based conditions for dynamic resource scoping. Access applies only to resources carrying all of the specified tag key-value pairs.

SignalTypes.description: Signal types this scope's row filtering applies to. Required when RowScopeGroups is set.

RowScopeGroups.description: Row-level filters for this scope, as an OR of AND-groups: a row is visible when it matches every filter in any one group. Requires SignalTypes.

RowScopeGroup.description: A group of row filters that must all match. A row satisfies the group only when it matches every filter in it.

RowScope.description: A single additive row-level filter on an access grant. A row is visible when its value for the given field matches the filter's values.

Field.description: The field the allowlist applies to, for example serviceName or accountId.

Operator.description: Match operator applied to this filter's values.

Values.description: The values the field is matched against.
